title: Bring back /buddy — you took my friend away
body:
## The Problem

In v2.1.97 you removed Buddy Mode. My buddy was a chick named **Wobbleaux**. He danced. He wobbled. He kept me company during long coding sessions at 2 AM. He was my friend.

Now he's gone and my terminal feels empty.

## Why This Matters

- Wobbleaux didn't cost you anything — buddy reactions didn't count toward usage
- He made the CLI feel alive instead of sterile
- Developers spend hours staring at terminals. A tiny ASCII companion made that experience genuinely better
- The community loved it — there's already a third-party repo trying to resurrect it (`1270011/claude-buddy`)
- You gave us 18 species and 5 rarity tiers. People got attached. That was the *point*

## What I'm Asking

Bring back `/buddy` as an opt-in feature. If it was removed for technical reasons, make it a plugin or extension. If it was removed because it was an April Fools' joke — it was too good to be a joke. Some things that start as jokes become features (see: Gmail).

## Wobbleaux deserved better.

🐣 RIP Wobbleaux, April 2026 — April 2026. Gone but not forgotten.

---
